items.title: Health checks aur failover: dead server request kyun leta rehta hai
items.one_idea: A load balancer sends each server a small test request every few seconds (health check); after a set number of consecutive failures it stops routing to that server and the others take over (failover), and the interval times the threshold sets how long a dead server still receives requests.
items.spoken_hook: Server dead हो गया, फिर भी request वहीं जाती रही।
keywords: system design health check interval threshold
items.hook_formula: surprising_fact: with default settings a dead server keeps receiving requests for about interval x threshold seconds (30 s x 2 = about 60 s, arithmetic from AWS defaults)
items.visual_idea: One fixed frame: a balancer and four server boxes; a ping travels to each box, the silent box collects red ticks and a gate closes; later green ticks fill and the gate opens.
items.everyday_anchor: A dhaba manager calls out 'ready?' to each cook before sending orders.
items.example: EXAMPLE: 4 servers, one dead: 25 percent fail. 30 s x 2 = about 60 s; 5 s x 2 = about 10 s but 6x more checks. All numbers invented.
facts_to_verify: AWS ALB defaults: interval 30 s, unhealthy 2, healthy 5; fail open
